NVIDIA open kernel driver + Wayland userspace for a VFIO GPU-passthrough CachyOS VM guest
Installs the CachyOS prebuilt open kernel module
(linux-cachyos-nvidia-open) + nvidia-utils, egl-wayland (KDE Wayland on
NVIDIA), the OpenCL ICD, nvidia-settings and the VA-API driver;
blacklists nouveau, enables nvidia-drm modeset=1, installs a boot-time
CDI-generation oneshot, and requests a reboot. Guest/bare-host only
(never in a container). Verifiable: the modprobe + CDI unit files land
and the egl-wayland / opencl-nvidia packages install.

## Acceptance plan

This candy's `plan:` — the runnable spec `charly check` executes against a live deployment. `check:` steps are idempotent probes; `run:` steps change state.

| `run` | write=/etc/modprobe.d/charly-nvidia.conf |
| `run` | write=/etc/systemd/system/charly-nvidia-cdi.service |

| `run` | command=u="$(getent passwd 1000 \| cut -d: -f1)" [ -n "$u" ] && usermod -aG video,render "$u" \|\| true |
| `check` | the nouveau blacklist + nvidia-drm modeset config is installed |
